samples.interpolation: linear independently over all six min/max bounds; endpoint reads clamp; negative/default time uses fighter.clock

facing: R and L source arrays verified byte-value-identical for each character; both combat facings use the same local bounds
runtime_embedded_rows: scripts/combat.gd ROUNDHOUSE_SURFACE_CURVES: depth minimum, depth maximum, height minimum, height maximum, forward minimum, forward maximum

contact_geometry.depth_overlap: interpolated depth minimum <= +0.25 and interpolated depth maximum >= -0.25

target_hurtbox.note: Target hurtbox is separately applied by the existing collector, never included in returned reach or foot bounds.

phase: Nominal active [0.28, 0.42); physical depth overlap is additionally required. Sampled overlaps are 0.33 through 0.40; interpolation determines sub-sample crossings, not a second hardcoded time window.
unchanged: Both character durations .90/.96; damage 13, guard 30, stun .28, push .30; facing-forward only; one contact per attack; no down targets; prior punch curves and flying kick unchanged.
limitations: Interpolated foot-surface AABB plus allowances and existing target hurtbox, not full mesh collision, continuous swept-volume collision or a 360-degree area attack.

contact_event_height.capture: Saved alongside contact kind/config before applying any simultaneous trade, so later attack/clock mutation cannot change it. Main presentation consumes it for roundhouse only.
